messages:
Sasha (CS): Quick sync — Evensong Labs wants a burst rehearsal tomorrow 09:00 UTC on their Dedicated pool. Goal: quota bump, autoscale stress, KMS key rollover validation, and a soak period. Can we scope risks and owners?
Ravi (CS): Evensong requested 2x usual qps for 30m, then sustain at 50%. They also noted renewal talk next week; want a clean run to show stability.
Hannah (SE): I can own the load harness and verify end-to-end traces. Need exact tokens/min target and whether we should enable prefix caching for their high-reuse prompts.
Marco (Infra): I can handle quota + autoscaler. Proposal: temp quota to 1.2M tokens/min, autoscale policy = soft-burst (scale 0->100% in 2m; cool down 10m). If that hits error rate >1% fallback to hosted-small model.
Sasha (CS): @Evensong Oncall will join. Also confirm KMS: they want key rotation during the rehearsal to validate our HSM flows.
Evensong Oncall: We'll be on the call. KMS key name: evensong-kms-2026. Will provide ARN 10m before start.
Marco (Infra): Commands I'll run (dry-run today):
```
# bump quota
redwoodctl quota update --org evensong --pool ev-prod-eu --tokens-per-min 1200000
# enable autoscale policy
redwoodctl autoscale apply --pool ev-prod-eu --policy soft-burst --timeout 30m
```
QA (load): Sharing the load script we'll use (small snippet):
```
# ramp to target over 5m, sustain 20m, spike windows 2m
python load_runner.py --pool ev-prod-eu --ramp 5m --sustain 20m --qps 700 --spike 1400
```
Hannah (SE): Can we add a KV-cache sanity check so we don't artificially inflate token counts? Suggest enabling prefix cache for this run: cache_mode=prefix-only.
Marco (Infra): Agreed. I'll enable prefix cache and pin model variant to gpt-small-quant-v2 to keep costs predictable.
deploy-bot: autoscaler v2.1 deployed to ev-prod-eu — commit abc123 (CI ✅) :rocket:
Ravi (CS): Can SRE have a quick rollback plan if latency > 500ms p95? We should predefine circuit-breaker thresholds and an operator to flip to hosted fallback.
Marco (Infra): Rollback plan: set pool weight=0 and route 100% to hosted-fallback via routing policy `evensong-fallback`. Command: `redwoodctl route shift --from-pool ev-prod-eu --to-route hosted-fallback --percent 100`. It's a single command and tested in staging.
Sasha (CS): Timing: dry-run today at 16:30 UTC (no customer), rehearsal tomorrow 09:00 UTC with customer on call. Post-run 30m retro with logs.
Hannah (SE): I'll collect traces and perf markers. Please tag requests with `evensong-rehearsal` header so we can filter easily.
Evensong Oncall: We'll send sample prompt set in the morning. Also want a short demo of KMS rotate + decrypt verification.
Marco (Infra): KMS steps I'll run: import new key material -> rotate alias -> run decrypt test on one dedicated node. Command: `kmsctl rotate --alias evensong-kms-2026 --verify`. Will notify when complete.
QA (load): I'll publish the load report to the shared folder and link in thread after run. Quick note: keep token accounting off for customer-visible metrics during the spike to avoid noisy billing alerts.
Ravi (CS): I'll notify Account Exec and Renewal lead, flagging that a successful run reduces renewal risk.
Sasha (CS): Action items:
- Marco: temp quota bump + autoscale policy apply (owner)
- Hannah: load harness + traces, prefix cache on (owner)
- QA: run load, publish results (owner)
- Evensong Oncall: provide KMS ARN + prompt set (owner)
- Ravi: update AE and Renewal (owner)
We'll reconvene 30m after the rehearsal for a quick go/no-go review. Any objections? :thumbsup::thumbsdown:
Marco (Infra): No objections. I'll post live status in #eng-oncall during run.
Hannah (SE): +1.
Ravi (CS): +1.
Evensong Oncall: Confirmed, see you tomorrow.
